recommendation: Stop following the single post-result case. Consider a separately registered coverage diagnosis of the already consumed historical training data, using a fixed sample independent of game returns and model performance.
proposed_sample: Select at most 200 training records by deterministic identity hash before inspecting them; report source controller arms and operation and completion-status coverage, including missing classes and same-target multi-worker opportunities.
limits: Use accepted training source and labels only, with fixed read, byte and time budgets; no test-panel analysis, new model forward, official replay, game or training. A small sample cannot establish teacher optimality, financial causation or generalization.
stop: Stop on source mismatch, unverified provenance, exceeded budget or insufficient sample; report uncertainty rather than changing the sample or thresholds. Any correction or future training requires a separate registration. No PPO or DAgger.
